config.simple.title: Common settings
config.simple.hint: Leave a box empty to use the standard value again. Every save keeps a backup, so you can go back.
config.raw.title: Your configuration file
config.raw.hint.pre: This is your own layer of this file:
config.raw.hint.post: It sits on top of the standard settings, so it only holds what you changed. A backup is made every time you save.
config.confirm.saveSimple: Save these settings? The old file is kept as a backup.
config.confirm.saveRaw: Replace your configuration with this text? The old file is kept as a backup.
config.simple.reassure: You usually don't need to change anything here.
config.simple.applies: The device picks most of these up as soon as you save. If something does not change, restart the OVOS services.
config.where.title: Where a setting comes from
config.where.hint: OVOS reads its configuration from several files, one after another, and a later file wins. If you changed something and nothing happened, a later file probably sets it too. Type a setting to see which file its value comes from.
config.where.mergedFrom: Merged from {n} files, last written in {where}
config.where.stack: All the configuration files, in the order they are merged
config.layer.patch: a runtime change from a skill or the bus
config.undo.confirm: Undo your last change and go back to the previous settings?
config.undo.none: There is no earlier version to go back to yet.
config.token.moved: Set the access token on the Control panel page
